Pulse 0.15.1

What's new:
- Search results are now curatable in place: a watched result's checkmark removes it from the current list (the result stays on screen), and the plus re-adds it. The detail page's watch entry becomes a star toggle — outline star adds to the selected group, filled star removes — mirrored on the pinned window title bar.
- Positions are decoupled from the watchlist. The position entry stays visible for every position-eligible instrument, whether watched or not. Trade records survive removal from every list: a removed instrument's history (open position, realized P&L, trade log) remains visible on its detail page, and the bottom area uniformly shows the record-position guidance when there are no records and the records when there are. Recording a position on an unlisted symbol no longer silently re-adds it to any list.
- The plus at the end of the group bar is hover-revealed and "New List" joins the tab context menu, so it no longer reads as the add-symbol entry (search remains the way to add symbols).

No setup is required after updating. Existing watchlists, positions, and dormant trade history are untouched.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.15.1.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
